_desc: Pending-tx silent-drop test. Triangle of alice/bob/carol with strong alice<->bob and alice<->carol links and a weak bob<->carol link. alice sends a long payload to bob first; ~1s later carol sends to alice. While alice is mid-flight (pending_tx set) the inbound RTS from carol used to trigger a NACK with reason=pending_tx (a pessimistic busy_for_ms estimate that lied in the failure case). New behavior: alice silently drops the RTS and emits rts_drop_pending_tx; carol's rts_timeout retries and the existing cascade machinery handle the rest. The assertion is positive presence of rts_drop_pending_tx on alice — proves the new code path fires at least once.
